notes.title: Playtest signups open!
notes.content:
🎮 Get Early Access to Chelesste! 🎮

We're thrilled to announce that we're launching an exclusive playtest version, and we want YOU to be a part of it!

Join us for an exclusive opportunity to get early access to Chelesste, where chess meets card games in an exciting and fun way. You'll also have the chance to influence the development process and help shape the game's future!

Here's what you can look forward to:

[olist]
  Get a sneak peek at gameplay mechanics, features and cards.
  Provide valuable feedback and suggestions that directly impact development choices.
  Collaborate with our "team" (one developer) to refine the game and make it the best it can be.
[/olist]
Sign up right from the store page, we can't wait to see you in game!
Also, as a treat, here is one of our KING cards. (subject to change of course)
- Str4nger
